title: a whitespace-only release ci.query, derived, after or gates item passes validation
body:
Found by vc's auditors in the 2026-09-21 doc audit (E1).

`_cfg_path_command_line` (lib/config) is the one list of keys whose value devbin splits into words and runs (issue 0082), and validation refuses a whitespace-only one there. The release core's `ci.query` and every `derived:`, `after:` and `gates:` item are command lines too and were not on it, so `doctor` passed a whitespace-only one and it failed only at the cut.

Fix: the list covers `release.ci.query` and `release.{derived,after,gates}.<n>`. Test: config.bats, "validation refuses a release command line or gate with no words in it", driven red at the parent commit.


## Resolution

Fixed at `213018e`, test driven red first at its parent commit. Full suite 1578/1579 at `ae3b200`: the one failing arm was environment-caused (GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 exported in the running shell defeated readonlygit.bats' stale fixture, and its control arm caught it) and is green in a clean environment; that file is hardened at `ad86870`. Reviewed by vc against this issue; vc's mutants on 0099 and 0104 were killed. Ships in 0.1.4.
